specification.problem: Synthesize two-qutrit ternary gates (controlled-shift CX3, SWAP3) from a Fourier gate F and the diagonal entangler CZ3 on two qutrits, as a variant of the abstract's TCX/TCZ-based synthesis; verify on the 9-dimensional subspace of a 4-level-per-qutrit qubit embedding.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Single tiny instance: two qutrits (a,b in {0,1,2}), each embedded in 2 qubits (level 3 untouched). Covers F, CZ3, CX3 = (I x F^dagger) CZ3 (I x F), and SWAP3 as three controlled-shift gates. Out of scope: Cartan decomposition of one-qutrit gates, physical implementation, Muthukrishnan-Stroud gates, Toffoli synthesis, general qudit extension, universality proof.

symbols.meaning: primitive cube root of unity e^{2\pi i/3}
computational basis labels of qutrit 1 and 2

equations.label: Fourier gate
equations.justification: Standard Weyl-Heisenberg qutrit definitions; not stated in abstract.

equations.label: Fourier conjugation
equations.description: Fourier gate maps shift to clock; sign convention should be checked in simulation (F X F^dagger = Z^{\pm1} depending on convention)
equations.justification: Direct calculation with the F defined above gives F X F^dagger = Z^{-1}... to be verified numerically; the sketch's sign may need correction.
assumptions: Implementation must verify sign and swap F with F^dagger if needed

equations.label: Diagonal entangler
equations.justification: Proposed native gate related to the abstract's TCZ gate.

equations.label: Controlled shift from CZ3
equations.description: TCX-like gate by Fourier conjugation on target
equations.abstract_quote: we propose the ternary controlled X (TCX) gate or the ternary controlled Z (TCZ) gate as the two-qutrit elementary gate
equations.justification: Inferred that TCX and TCZ are interconvertible by one-qutrit gates. Exact F vs F^dagger ordering depends on convention and is to be checked.
assumptions: Sign convention fixed by numerical check

equations.label: Ternary SWAP
equations.description: Three controlled shifts: b->b+a, a->a-b, b->b+a gives (a,b)->(a,a+b)->(-b,a+b)->(-b,a); the net result is a swap up to a sign (-b), so a final one-qutrit negation (|j>->|-j>) is needed to give an exact swap
equations.justification: Correction to the sketch: tracing the sequence yields (-b,a), not (b,a); an extra parity/negation permutation fixes it. Alternatively use the a->a-b, b->b+a, a->a-b ordering.
assumptions: Compose with negation gates or verify numerically

registers.name: q1
registers.role: qutrit 1, level j encoded as binary integer j, level 3 unused

specification.initial_state: Any state in the 9-dimensional subspace; unitary is verified on basis states |a,b>.

steps.description: Embed each qutrit in 2 qubits and build F, F^dagger, X, Z as 4x4 unitaries acting as identity on level 3.
Build CZ3 as diagonal phases omega^{ab} on the 9 states, identity elsewhere.
Compose CX3 by conjugating the target with F.
Compose three controlled shifts (with sign correction) to form SWAP3.

specification.classical_postprocessing: Compare the simulated unitary on the 9-dimensional subspace to target permutation or phase matrices.
assumptions: Gate set is Fourier plus diagonal entangler, differing from the abstract's TCX/Cartan route
Level 3 of each embedding is untouched, so unitarity requires identity extension
